description_en: Queries the status of origin servers under load balancing instances. You can specify multiple load balancing instance IDs in a single request, separated by commas
description_zh: 查询负载均衡器下源站状态，一次可以传多个负载均衡器id，用逗号拼接
name: ListLoadBalancerOriginStatus

parameters.help_en: The load balancing instance IDs. To query multiple load balancing instances, separate the IDs with commas. You can specify up to 100 load balancing instance IDs in a single request. You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2868897.html operation to obtain the load balancing instance IDs
parameters.help_zh: 负载均衡器ID，查多个负载均衡器时，ID用逗号拼接，最多一次传100个负载均衡器ID，负载均衡器ID可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2868897.html接口获取
parameters.name: load_balancer_ids

parameters.help_en: The type of the origin IPAM pool. Various origin IPAM pools are configured under the load balancing instance, such as the default IPAM pool, fallback IPAM pool, and primary region IPAM pool. Only the status of origin servers in the default IPAM pool affects the status of the load balancing instance itself. If you set this parameter to default_pool, only the status of origin servers in the default origin IPAM pool under the load balancing instance is queried
parameters.help_zh: 源地址池类型，负载均衡器下配置了各种源地址池，有默认地址池、兜底地址池、一级region地址池等，只有默认地址池下的源站状态，会影响负载均衡器本身的状态。传default_pool时表示只查负载均衡器下默认源地址池里的源站状态
parameters.name: pool_type

OriginStatus.description_en: The list of origin server statuses under the load balancing instance
OriginStatus.description_zh: 负载均衡器下源站状态列表

LoadBalancerId.description_en: The ID of the load balancing instance

PoolType.description_en: The type of the origin IPAM pool to which the origin server belongs under the load balancing instance. Only default_pool (default IPAM pool) is displayed. For other types, an empty string is returned
PoolType.description_zh: 源站所属的源地址池，在此负载均衡器下的类型，只有default_pool（默认地址池）会显示，其他类型返回均为空字符串

Reason.description_en: The reason for the probe failure

Status.description_en:
The origin server status. Valid values:
healthy: The probe result indicates that the origin server is active.
unhealthy: The probe result indicates that the origin server is unavailable.
unknown: The status is unknown because the monitor has not probed the origin server yet.
undetected: The load balancing instance to which the origin server belongs is not bound to a monitor
Status.description_zh:
源站状态：
健康(healthy)：探测结果为可用。
不健康(unhealthy)：探测结果为不可用。
未知(unknown)：未知，监视器还未进行探测。
未监控(undetected)：源站所属的负载均衡器未绑定监视器

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to track the request
